incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: High error rate detected for /v1/generate — 502/5xx spike in eu-west1, error rate 8.7% (>5% threshold). Auto-page fired.
pagerduty: Incident #INC-2024-349 triggered and routed to oncall group.
maria (oncall): acked. I’m on it, switching to incident channel.
jon (sre): seeing keepalive/reset spikes from the ingress logs around the same window. stack traces show `upstream prematurely closed connection` 502s.
sam (edge): confirmed: nginx upstream error lines spike at T+00:03, concurrent conns jumped ~2.8x. Could be backend keepalive exhaustion.
maria (oncall): quick customer-impact check — dashboard shows 12% of requests for embeddings/generate failing for some customers in EU. Support impact flagged. @carol please notify affected customers with a brief note.
carol (support): on it — drafting short status update, will send to customers impacted by EU region only.
lee (platform): is this tied to the recent keepalive tuning change we rolled last week? Rollback possible quickly?
jon (sre): yes config change `proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection` was tweaked. I’m running a quick query:
```
# k8s logs
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=ingress-eu --since=15m | grep "upstream prematurely closed connection" | wc -l
```
Found ~420 hits in last 10m.
maria (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) force route EU traffic to standby proxy pool (weight shift) 2) revert keepalive tweak on a single canary host 3) temporarily increase proxy workers. Jon/sam take steps 1 & 2.
jon (sre): doing weight shift now — changing route weights: `lbctl set-weight ingress-eu-primary=10 ingress-eu-standby=90`
sam (edge): weight change applied. Monitoring for latency spike.
jon (sre): starting canary rollback on one node: applying previous config and restarting ingress pod.
incident-bot: Automation: route change applied and pod rollout started.
maria (oncall): monitoring error-rate graph — beginning to drop from 8.7% -> 6.1% after reroute. Keepalive rollback on canary in progress.
jon (sre): canary rolled back and passed smoke checks. Rolling to remainder with 30s stagger.
lee (platform): provisioning extra proxy pods as hotfix (scale to 1.5x) to absorb burst.
maria (oncall): good. Carol please push customer note: brief outage in eu-west1, errors for generation endpoints, mitigation underway, ETA 15m.
carol (support): sent. Slack snippet: "We’re seeing elevated 5xx errors in eu-west1 affecting generation endpoints. Engineers are mitigating; next update in 15 minutes."
maria (oncall): error-rate down to 2.2% and continuing downward. Confirming impact narrow to <1% customers now.
jon (sre): postmortem notes to capture: keepalive change + traffic surge = upstream socket exhaustion. Action items: add canary gating for keepalive changes, add low-latency alerts for TCP resets, and autoscale proxy earlier.
maria (oncall): handing to oncall followup rotation — @jon please own follow-up, I’ll update the incident ticket and close once error-rate stable <0.5% for 30m.
pagerduty: Incident #INC-2024-349 acknowledged by maria and assigned to jon.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: error rate returned to baseline. Closing page after handoff. :white_check_mark:
